success_criteria.primary: confirmation seed 311, eq_norm_cov, 481 untouched test pairs, frozen procedure
success_criteria.notes: modes must include every nonzero dominant FFT mode of the true phase blocks (evaluation-only); baselines are exponent_search, monomial_ridge, rff4 on the known coordinate pairing; rotation is a fixed random orthogonal map of the 32-d code

selection_rule: highest seed-303 validation accuracy on the 240 validation pairs; ties go to larger n_shift, then grid order
discovery_inputs: the real 32-d code and opaque shift index pairs (x, Tx) inside the fitting pool; no coordinate pairing, operand identities, labels or target frequencies
decoder_inputs: shear target (2,1) and shear labels of the fitting pool for one global output phase
